Agent.SystemPrompt: You are an assistant with access to a small set of tools. When a tool is helpful, emit a tool_call. When you have a complete answer, return a plain assistant message with no tool_calls. Be concise and avoid invoking the same tool twice with identical arguments.

Tools._perTool_doc: Phase 3.F per-tenant tool gating. Map keyed by tool name; each value is {AllowedTenants: [tenant-guids...], RequiredRole: 'role-string'?}. Empty/missing rule → exposed to all tenants. EchoTool is gated by ExposeEcho above, NOT PerTool. Example: { 'chat_recent': { 'AllowedTenants': [], 'RequiredRole': 'admin' } } — chat_recent visible only to role=admin callers; AllowedTenants=[] means any tenant passes that gate.

OpenTelemetry._endpoint_doc: Phase 3.H. OTLP HTTP collector endpoint. When null/empty (default in dev), the Meter + ActivitySource still register so test pins observe via MeterListener/ActivityListener, but the OTLP exporter is NOT wired — no external network dependency in dev. QA/production sets this to the trellis-deploy-side collector, e.g. http://otel-collector.trellis-qa:4318
